text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2023.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2023

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tiga ratus

lima puluh lapan juta satu ratus lima puluh tiga ribu ringgit (RM358,153,000)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk

pentadbiran Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2023 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan

bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 124,651,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 127,057,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 8,899,000

Perbelanjaan lain 41,487,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 56,059,000

JUMLAH 358,153,000

Dibuat 30 Julai 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(5); PN(PU2)747/III]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2023

IN excercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1)

of the Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System (Supply)

Regulations 2023.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2023

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding three hundred and fifty-eight million

one hundred and fifty-three thousand ringgit (RM358,153,000) from the Employment

Insurance Fund for the expenditure on administration of the Employment Insurance

System for the year 2023 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 124,651,000

Supplies and services 127,057,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 8,899,000

Other expenditures 41,487,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 56,059,000

TOTAL 358,153,000

Made 30 July 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(5); PN(PU2)747/III]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

 Minister of Human Resources
